notes: Self-declared "puzzle room" whose gate is a locked door opened by spelling a word on the floor tiles, so it is Puzzle; I checked Word / Quiz Puzzle first, but its puzzle-open plaza contradicts a compact walled room and the answer here is walked rather than typed, so Escape Room on rooms-sequence (Sealed Chambers) is the better fit and the stage tracker implies a run of such rooms. The oversized key tiles are literally pressure plates, which is button-solve, and the Word Puzzle Door is gate-progression; the preset's collectible-nodes was dropped because nothing is carried, and facade-clue because every piece of information the prompt specifies lives in the ScreenGui and in tile colour rather than on a wall. Obby & Platformer is named as secondary only to reach hazard-kill for the Delete/F4 tiles that fall away or kill on contact, which no loaded Puzzle or Universal row expresses; its genre-wide P6 does not follow it into a mix it does not lead, and nothing here needs topology valid by construction, so the build stays on P0. Decided without a user: a clean tech-lab room, 8x8-stud key tiles making one room-sized keyboard floor per stage, interior-only so there is no exterior transition; the Luau scripts, colour feedback and timer UI are mechanics outside layout scope.
